Text: Main Settlement
A sprawling ancient facility, repurposed as living space.
Park
Beneath a geodesic dome, this pre-Collapse terrarium has been reborn as a public park.
Hydroponic Farm
Built on technology pioneered by the ancient Galileo Institute, this farm contains row after row of edible plants bred for life in space.
Synthohol Plant
This terrarium was repurposed to grow plants suitable for fermentation. A makeshift still allows them to be converted to alcohol on-site.
Pleasure District
Once a scientific facility, this complex was later repurposed to serve the needs of any who need solace and pleasure, no matter their affiliation.
Armory
Before the Collapse, this Interstellar Authority facility stored weapons for their officers.
Ark Ship

This ancient ship was designed by Galileo Institute scientists to ferry large populations across the stars in relative comfort. Its journeying days are over, but it can still house commoner and noble alike.
Shipyard
A pre-Collapse spacedock and shipyard, once operated by the League of Spacefaring Nations. Capable of ship manufacture and repair.
Repair Platform
An ancient spacedock, adjoining a repair and engineering facility. Cannot manufacture new ships, but can charge for repair services.
Retrofitting Platform
A pre-Collapse spacedock originally intended for civilian loading and refitting, but repurposed over the centuries for the needs of warfare.
Parts Factory
Thanks to its Orion Industries "Flexi-Factory" system, this pre-Collapse factory could provide parts from any blueprints in its decaying database.
Interstellar Authority Outpost
Before the Collapse, the Interstellar Authority were the forces of law across the cosmos - for better or worse. Their abandoned outposts still inspire fear.
Electronics Factory

This ancient factory, built by Orion Industries, was designed to efficiently turn out miniaturised devices. They can transmit across vast distances but are difficult to detect, making them perfect for intelligence work.
Hospital
Though its medical technology is poorly understood, this facility's staff can use it to heal, even if they don't understand quite why it works.
Jail
This ancient NovaCorp science facility, with thousands of observation and containment rooms, was repurposed into a prison some centuries ago.
Incinerator
Why the pre-Collapse firm NovaCorp built such a thorough incinerator is a mystery. Perhaps this indicates how successful this facility was.
Blue Dust Mine
Blue Dust: a rare chemical found only in certain asteroid deposits. A potent drug loved by the masses. A goldmine more profitable than gold.
Viridium Mine

Viridium: the rare mineral crucial for the construction of ships and stations, and which forms the basis of galactic currency. Though centuries old, and though passing through many hands, this mine has been a constant source of profit - and greed.
Ore Mine
Constructed centuries ago to supply metallic ores to nearby space, this ancient Orion Industries facility can still fulfil its original purpose.
Refueling Station
An orbital station to ease fleet refuelling. Local folklore speaks of ancient traders stopping here, but since the Collapse this facility has been used mostly for military purposes.
Trade Hub
Once a hub in a complex web of digital purchases, this trade facility could become a bustling market where merchants hawk their physical goods.
Defense Platform
Originally an Interstellar Authority fortress, this fearsome station is still capable of raining devastating fire on unwelcome visitors.
Research Station

This science facility was designed and operated by the Galileo Institute before the Collapse. Though many instruments are damaged or beyond your ken, it could still be used to gather intelligible scientific data.
Solar Array
This station, orbiting this system's star, provides power to the entire colony. With more power, more ancient systems can be reactivated.
Combat Simulator
This facility, designed to train pre-Collapse pilots and peacekeepers, can still continue its legacy of violence today.

Arena
Once an auditorium for pre-Collapse scientists, this facility was repurposed into an Arena some decades ago.

Archives
Though so much has been lost, facilities like this League of Spacefaring Nations archive still bear the seeds of history.
Simulator
This virtual reality simulator was designed to train any number of vocations for life in space, to ready the citizens of the past. Though the times have changed, its lessons could still be welcome.
Data Center
Although the League of Spacefaring Nations built this to manage a smaller pre-Collapse population, its databanks and algorithms could still be helpful for cataloguing your own.
Barracks
Though the troops within are no longer Interstellar Authority officers, this facility promises to continue its legacy of violence.
Communications Hub
Though worn, this facility can still convey messages between vast reaches of space, helping rulers stay in contact and easing diplomacy.
Security Center
This pre-Collapse facility was designed to help the Interstellar Authority surveil and investigate suspects. Though times have changed, intelligence work remains crucial.
Laboratory
This workshop of wonders may never be fully understood, but its scientific marvels are more than mere toys.
Corporate Tower
The corporations of the pre-Collapse were ruthless and profit-driven. Their installations are excellent for extracting wealth.
Experimental Lab
Though poorly understood, the marvels in this ancient NovaCorp lab are designed to kill: subtly, discreetly, and anonymously.
Shuttle Hangar
Shuttle travel is the logistical backbone of the cosmos. By making it more convenient, this facility can smooth logistics and diplomacy.
Message Drone Hangar

Message drones are required to send faster-than-light messages across starlanes. By industrialising the message system, this facility can make the hassle of messages - whether conventional or secret - more convenient.
Starlane Edge Port
At the edge of its system, this facility maximises starlane throughput, making travel - and long-distance governance - easier.
Hidden Hangar
It is unknown if this was once a pirate base, a concealed NovaCorp hangar, or a secret Interstellar Authority staging post. Across its lifetime it may have been all three.
Grain Silo
Designed to store supplies in vacuum deep-freeze, this facility could hold hydroponics yields, and keep them from spoiling longer.
Chemical Warehouse
In a galaxy of hermetic colonies, supplying the right chemical at the right time is critical to a smooth domain. The more experimental substances may have uses in intelligence work.
Medical Station
According to folklore, the sick need only spend a few months here to feel well again. The reality seems to involve pills, exercise and medical robots, but the result is the same.
Assembly Plant
Once an Orion Industries weapons plant, this factory can still feed the engines of war in conflicts its designers never imagined.
Waste Processing Plant
The pre-Collapse Galileo Institute recognised the importance of reclaiming waste out in the cosmos. They did not anticipate how profitable this might be.
Scrap Processing Plant
Though designed by its Orion Industries founders as a simple metal reclamation plant, after the Collapse this facility was used to scrounge materials for shipbuilding and weapons manufacture.
Orbital Hydroponics
Though its primary use is to grow food, a private stroll through the greenery has been known to ease diplomatic tensions.
Chemical Processing Plant
Chemical reclamation is a profitable enterprise. The resulting substances can be put to some creative, and subtle, uses.
Plasma Processing Plant
The reclaimed plasma from this facility was used, before the Collapse, by corporation and Galileo Institute scientist alike. Now it powers the devices they left behind.
Warehouse
Though the technology to fabricate new colonies escapes us, the parts and blueprints from this storehouse are invaluable in repairing what survives.
Shuttle Factory
Shuttles are the backbone of interstellar travel and communication. Manufacturing them will ease logistical concerns and smooth diplomacy, and they are always in demand.
Convict Ship

Originally an Interstellar Authority detention ship, this facility was left to rot after the Collapse, its population becoming ever more aggressive and hopeless. Releasing some on unsuspecting stations would cause mayhem.
Defense Platform Fabricator
Originally built by the League of Spacefaring Nations before the Collapse, this facility manufactured orbital defence turrets.
Spy Centre
Though designed to monitor illegal activities by the Interstellar Authority, this surveillance centre can be used to monitor and manage vassals in the post-Collapse era.
Command Centre
Originally a League of Spacefaring Nations command post before the Collapse, this strategic facility can be used to plan complex military operations.
Ship Fabrication Plant
While the supply of new ships slowed to a trickle after the Collapse, facilities like this ensure that new ships are being built - if slowly.
Courier Landing Bay
Originally designed as a covert landing base, this facility hidden on an uncolonised moon can conceal a large flotilla.
